measurementRules.rule: Q is the calibrated sum of complete set net content masses at unique first release; retain all configured play contents and functional printed instructions, actual retained ink/moisture once, tare out every sales/transport package and reject. No catalogue count-to-mass assumption.

measurementRules.required_unit: Native kg or MJ or m3 per card
measurementRules.rule: Mass does not replace energy/volume. Convert source units once with independently evidenced state-specific density/assay; integrate actual rates only, not already integrated volumes. No secondary-coefficient density or nominal set/machine mass.

measurementRules.required_unit: Native numerator unit per kg reference product
measurementRules.rule: Collect raw numerators undivided; section8 owns the only quotient. Burden A/A_H and gross physical V/V_H are different channels; card/aggregation basis cites that same single result, without another division, stock correction or physical allocation. Q or Q_H=0 retains loads without unit result.

calculationRules.rule: For burden-bearing manufacturing dimensions only, after source-unit conversion and justified exchange-specific attribution: A = B_open + U - B_close - T_other. B_close is limited by b_stocks; already-stock-corrected consumption is not corrected again. T_other requires a real independent function/cohort and one justified vector transfer, never ordinary waste/reject/sample sale or external disposal. Gross V never uses this stock equation.

A_H is the actual incremental service vector already performed for original cohort Q_H during observed H, including correctly inherited service draw and real failed work/treatment after justified exchange-specific attribution. Carry only truly unused/unassigned service/charge, not already performed held-FG service. Full gross V_H is independent, not stock-corrected or burden-scaled.

Exactly once: a = N / D. For manufacture burden N=A and D=Q. For manufacture physical gross cards N=the complete actual gross leg V and D=Q. For post-release service burden N=A_H and D=original Q_H. For post-release physical gross cards N=the complete actual gross leg V_H and D=original Q_H. Retain each native numerator unit per kg. Card/aggregation labels only cite this same a; no subsequent division, stock correction, allocation of gross mass, second purchase/provider charge or automatic credit. D=0 retains actual data without unit result.

For each pool: opening + P + I + ER + CP_in = closing + gross S + EO + W + CP_out, at actual full wet states. CP contains only real disjoint component/natural or operational water changes. X_in/X_out removes overlap only with OTHER same-side incoming/outgoing terms, never new ingress retained in stocks or full closing mass. Whole wet article and constituents, or mixed total and originW, are not additive. No internal reuse acquisition or credit.

calculationRules.rule: 仅制造负荷维度先原单位转换及逐交换正当归属：A = B_open + U - B_close - T_other。B_close受b_stocks限制，已库存校正耗用不再校正。T_other须真实独立功能/cohort及一次正当向量移交，不因普通废物/拒品/样品销售或外部处置而扣。实物毛V绝不用此库存式。
A_H为观测H内已为原cohort Q_H实际执行的增量服务向量，含正确继承服务提取、真实失败作业/处理及逐交换正当归属。仅真实未用/未分配服务/负荷结转，不能扣已执行留库FG服务。完整毛V_H独立，不作库存校正或负荷缩量。
仅一次：a = N / D。制造负荷N=A、D=Q；制造实物毛卡N=完整真实毛腿V、D=Q；放行后服务负荷N=A_H、D=原Q_H；放行后实物毛卡N=完整真实毛腿V_H、D=原Q_H。各原生分子单位按每kg保留。卡/aggregation仅引用同一个a，不再除、不再库存校正、不分配实物毛质量、不再采购/provider收费或自动信用。D=0保留真实数据但不出单位结果。
各池：opening + P + I + ER + CP_in = closing + 毛S + EO + W + CP_out，均真实完整湿态。CP仅真实互斥组件/自然或作业水变化。X_in/X_out仅去其他同侧入/出流项重叠，不去留在库存的新增入流或完整期末质量。整湿件与组分、混废总量与originW不加和。内部复用不造采购或信用。
